'''November 2000 Bossier City tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Bossier City, Louisiana on 4 November 2000. [[Jeremy Sumrall]] won it. It is known from Jeremy Sumrall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1415">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-bossier-city-la-11-4-00d1415/ bossier-city-la-11-4-00], DeckTech (Jeremy "pakkratt" Sumrall, 5 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-bossier-city-la-11-4-00d1415/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Bossier City, Louisiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Jeremy Sumrall]]
